newsitem.title: PERU: Peru lost 15 pct fewer man-hrs to strikes Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Peru lost 15 pct fewer man-hrs to strikes Jan-July.

text.p: Peru lost 689,164 man-hours in 55 strikes in the private sector during the first seven months of 1996, 15.4 percent less than the hours lost in 76 strikes during the same period last year, the government said Friday.
There were six strikes in July 1996, the same as July last year, according to statistics from the Labor Ministry.
The construction sector accounted for 25 percent of strikes in the first seven months, followed by 22 percent in the mining sector.
Peru lost a total 1.049 million man-hours through strikes in 1995, down from 1.937 million in 1994.
This figure has fallen dramatically from the total 15.068 million man-hours lost in 1990 when President Alberto Fujimori's government took power.
